headline: DPM DRILLS 713 METRES at 2.52 g/t AuEq in Major Bulgarian Porphyry Discovery — Hole Still Open
snippet: DPM Metals announced a major new gold-copper porphyry discovery at Brevene South, Bulgaria — 1 km from the operating Chelopech mine — with standout hole EX_BRESPO_03 returning 713m at 2.52 g/t AuEq (1.31 g/t Au, 1.16% Cu) from 1,172m depth, hole still in progress. RBC called it a 'potentially very high-grade porphyry system'; five drill rigs are now on site with 15,000m more planned for 2026.

headline: GOLD DETHRONES US TREASURIES as World's Top Reserve Asset — ECB Data Shows 27% vs. 22%
snippet: The ECB's 2025 annual reserve data shows gold now accounts for 27% of global official reserves, overtaking US Treasuries at 22% for the first time since 1996. Central banks accumulated over 1,000 tonnes per year for three consecutive years, and gold prices surging above $5,500/oz in early 2026 magnified the valuation shift.

headline: GOLD LOGS 7th STRAIGHT LOSS to $4,440 — AngloGold Off 13%, Newmont 8% as Fed Hike Bets Surge
snippet: Gold extended its losing streak to seven consecutive sessions — its longest since 2023 — as US strikes on Iranian military sites pushed oil higher, fanning inflation fears and driving traders to price in a 50%+ chance of a Fed rate hike in January. AngloGold Ashanti fell 13%, Hecla Mining 11%, Kinross 10%, Newmont and Barrick each 8%.

headline: AYA SILVER Hits 5,100 g/t Over 2 Metres in At-Depth Drilling at Zgounder — Multiple Bonanza Holes
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver's at-depth drill program at the Zgounder silver mine in Morocco hit multiple high-grade intercepts, headlined by 5,100 g/t Ag over 2m within a 1,867 g/t Ag over 6m interval. A separate hole returned 2,176 g/t Ag over 8.4m including 4,298 g/t over 2m; the 2026 program is 30.8% complete at 9,250m drilled.

headline: COPPER Near $6.50/lb as Chile Posts Worst April Output in 23 Years; US Tariff Review Due
snippet: Copper held near $6.50/lb after Trump signed a tariff proclamation widening the US copper premium, drawing metal stateside ahead of a June tariff policy review. Chile — the world's largest producer — reported its weakest April output in 23 years, while COMEX inventories hit a record 450,000 tonnes as LME and Shanghai stocks fell over 55% since August.

headline: GoldSeek: Gold Has Key Support at $3,950–$4,250 Before June 17 FOMC — Don't Exit Yet
snippet: Asian Metals Market analysis argues near-dated CME gold futures have strong technical support between $3,950–$4,250, and that the June 17 FOMC meeting is the real pivot point for precious metals. Price falls before the meeting are part of a medium-term bullish setup; falls after the meeting would warrant a strategic exit.

headline: PAN AMERICAN SILVER Commits $146 Million to Timmins Expansion; 118,000m Drill Year Planned
snippet: Pan American Silver is advancing a $146M phased development at Timmins, Ontario, including a 625m Bell Creek shaft extension and new drifts to the Vogel and Samson deposits. A 118,000m exploration and resource conversion drill program is underway for 2026, with an updated mineral reserve and resource estimate expected in Q3.

headline: AMERICAS GOLD & SILVER Drills 599 g/t Ag Over 14m at Cosalá — More Than 5x the Modeled Resource Grade
snippet: Americas Gold and Silver's infill drilling at the Cosalá Complex, Mexico is returning 2–5x modeled inferred resource grades; highlight hole SR568 cut 599.8 g/t Ag and 0.8% Cu over 14m in a zone modeled at 110 g/t — a 5x upgrade. Results are adjacent to existing infrastructure and being incorporated into an optimized H2 2026 mine plan.

headline: CAMECO and Orano Buy Out TEPCO's Cigar Lake Stake for $116M as Uranium Consolidation Tightens
snippet: Cameco and Orano Canada agreed June 1 to acquire TEPCO Resources' 5% interest in the Cigar Lake uranium mine for ~$115.75M, bringing Cameco's stake to 57.4% and Orano's to 42.5%. The deal eliminates the last minority partner from the world's highest-grade uranium operation, expected to close Q3 2026.

headline: CHINA Silver Imports Hit Record 836 Tonnes in March as Solar and Retail Demand Overwhelm Supply
snippet: GoldSeek's SWOT report highlights China's silver imports surging to an all-time high of 836 tonnes in March 2026, driven by record solar industry consumption and strong retail investment buying following silver's $121/oz January peak. The import pace means China has absorbed over 790 tonnes in early 2026 alone, structurally pressuring above-ground global supply.
